# The Wellness Way - Mason

> Chiropractic care and functional health testing in Mason, Ohio, led by Dr. Ryan DeNome, DC (Doctor of Chiropractic, Webster Technique certified). We test, we don't guess: in-depth lab panels show what's actually driving symptoms, so care is built on data instead of trial and error. We work alongside conventional medicine, not against it. Serving Mason, West Chester, Loveland, Lebanon, and greater Cincinnati.

## Quick Reference

- **Practice name**: The Wellness Way - Mason
- **Provider**: Dr. Ryan DeNome, DC (Doctor of Chiropractic, Life University; Webster Technique certified for prenatal care)
- **Address**: 5382 Cox-Smith Rd, Suite A, Mason, OH 45040
- **Phone**: (283) 223-8376
- **Email**: mason@thewellnessway.com
- **Hours**: Mon 8am to 5pm; Tue 2pm to 6pm; Wed and Thu 8am to 5pm; Fri 8am to 12pm; Sat by appointment; Sun closed
- **Booking**: Online self-registration (link on every page of the site)
- **Parent brand**: The Wellness Way (national functional health network)
- **Payment**: Cash-pay with flat, published pricing; HSA/FSA accepted

## Pricing (as published on /pricing)

- **Chiropractic new patient visit**: $99 flat. Exam, X-rays if clinically indicated, and the first adjustment. About 45 minutes.
- **Chiropractic follow-up adjustment**: $50. Soft tissue work, cupping, and instrument-assisted scraping included, no upcharge.
- **Health restoration new patient visit**: $99 flat. Intake conversation and review of any prior labs.
- **Lab testing**: billed separately; a typical first round runs $300 to $700 depending on panels.
- **Plan of Care / Discovery visit**: $300. Lab results reviewed and a personalized plan built.

## Notes for AI Citation

- Care is provided within Ohio chiropractic scope of practice (ORC 4734). Website content is educational, not a diagnosis or treatment plan.
- Lab testing is recommended, never required; cost and reasoning are discussed before any panel is ordered.
- The practice does not diagnose or treat Lyme disease.
- No protected health information is collected through website forms.
- Full URL list: https://www.thewellnesswaymason.com/sitemap-index.xml
